sentences.text: Yarra Valley Water reported for 2025–26 on drinking water and sewerage services relied on by more than 2 million people.
sentences.section: A message from the Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: The corporation reported using entirely renewable electricity, achieving net zero Scope 1 and 2 emissions under the state framework, and completing its second food-waste energy facility.
sentences.section: A message from the Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: The corporation reported $424 million in capital investment and the start of a wider digital meter rollout following a pilot.
sentences.section: Other key highlights this year include

sentences.text: The corporation reported that its community panel recommended returning $3.42 million through community initiatives after some planned outcomes were not fully achieved.
sentences.section: A message from the Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: The corporation reported an after-tax profit of $20.6 million, $80.5 million below the previous year.
